description: This PHP class defines a custom dashlet for displaying and interacting with SurveyQuestions in the SuiteCRM platform. It extends a generic dashlet class and initializes dashlet properties including title, search fields, and columns based on metadata.

classes.name: SurveyQuestionsDashlet
classes.description: A dashlet class for displaying SurveyQuestions in SuiteCRM, extending DashletGeneric and initializing display parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method initializes the dashlet with title, search fields, columns, and seed bean based on provided definitions and metadata.
